systems.country_label: South African School Administration and Management System (SA-SAMS)

systems.tiers: rolled out to provinces for managing infrastructure projects; provinces not adequately using it
teachers record their training in it; many do not
government payroll; records reasons for resignation

note: No fact: the meeting report names SA-SAMS without saying what it does, so it is unclassified. What it states of it: the Auditor-General reported for 2024/25 that the SA-SAMS modernisation project was delayed by a year because it relied on donor funding, and recommended that the Council of Education Ministers and HEDCOM accelerate it (meeting of 24 October 2025). It also reports a planned electronic stock monitoring of the school nutrition programme across 23,000 public schools, unnamed.
